site.timezone: America/Los_Angeles review-machine context; customer site timezone not calibrated
site.coordinateSystem: generated top-lift-column demo layout, meter units; customer CAD origin not calibrated

demandProfile.source: internal DES stress input, not WCS/MES export

rows.inboundCompleted: output metric, not input; see generated review JSON
rows.outboundCompleted: output metric, not input; see generated review JSON
rows.notes: Stress input used for the review DES. Replace with measured hourly WCS/MES exports before site capacity claim.

ports.notes: Review baseline uses 30s lift and 30s lower. Replace with PLC or synchronized video timing.

shuttleMotion.source: demo scenario physics parameters, not vendor commissioning log
shuttleMotion.notes: Replace with vendor motion spec and commissioning logs before real-site claim.

layoutDimensions.source: generated top-lift-column layout; remaining dimensions are assumption-grade
layoutDimensions.units: meter in simulation, convert from customer CAD if supplied in mm

liftPorts.direction: inbound or outbound by generated top-lift region
liftPorts.notes: Replace with CAD export or dimensioned top-down drawing.

loadAndClearanceEnvelope.notes: Replace with vendor drawings and customer clearance standard.

blockedCellsAndNoDriveZones.source: current generated profile; no customer CAD exclusions loaded

blockedCells.reason: 0 blocked cells in current internal review profile
blockedCells.notes: Replace with structural blocked cells and maintenance exclusion zones from CAD/site survey.

controlPolicy.liftQueueCapacity: scenario/API default; not customer WCS export
controlPolicy.sourceBufferCapacity: scenario/API default; not customer WCS export
controlPolicy.repositionPolicy: review DES baseline; cap 6 balanced against cap 8 congestion
controlPolicy.notes: Replace with WCS/WES dispatch, queue, storage, and release rules.

visualValidationSamples.expectedObservation: vehicle arrival, lift action, load attach/detach, and departure
visualValidationSamples.notes: Internal visual evidence only. Replace with synchronized site video and task timestamps.

acceptanceThresholds.source: internal review bands, not customer signed threshold
acceptanceThresholds.notes: Customer acceptance thresholds are required before pass/fail capacity claim.
